full_judgment: 3. The defendants contested the suit by filling written statements denyine all the material allegations in the plaint contending, inter alia, that C.S. Khatian No.32 was published in the mane of Azimuddin and others. Money Case No.2159 of 1942 was filed by the then Zaminder for arrear of rent before the third Munsif Court, Bogra against the C.S. recorded holder and obtained decree and filed Execution Case No.1143 of 1943. The said Zaminder auctioned the said land on 13.11.1943. Thereafter, Azimuddin Pramanik, Mishu Pramanik and Bahar Pramanik through settlement order took pattan from the Zaminder on 13.01.1951 and on the same date, other C.S. tenants through another settlement order took pattan from the Zaminder for the remaining part of the land. Accordingly, the gift deed being No.1612 dated 13.04.1942 was executed by Isup Pramanik is void. Bahar's daughter-Saton sold 54 decimals land in favour of Shahimuddin vide registered deed No.2262 dated 24.11.1952 and 48 decimals land in favour of Mishu Pramanik and M.R.R Khatian No.66 comprising 96 decimals land was published in the name of Azimuddin, M.R.R. Khatian No.49 comprising 405 acres land was published in the name of the heirs of Mishu Pramanik, M.R.R Khatian No.65 comprising 206 acres land was published in the name of Azimuddin. After the death of Azimuddin, his heirs opened separate Holding No.714 and enjoying the same and therefore, the suit is not maintainable.
